statements.fullStatement: District 7's audit directive means operational transparency starts now—not after opening. We'll pre-audit every intake workflow and expenditure line before the first patient walks in. Every inspection report, every certificate, every audit-ready spreadsheet—that's how you build Temescal's trust.
